nodes.label: Rollup Visualizer
nodes.rationale: Standalone HTML report. The page title is Rollup Visualizer; a second script measures the window and calls drawChart with the embedded bundle data.

nodes.label: rollup-plugin-visualizer
nodes.rationale: The page title, treemap sidebar, size labels, and version-2 payload (tree, nodeParts, nodeMetas, gzip, brotli, sourcemap) match the rollup-plugin-visualizer report. The plugin name is not printed in the file.

nodes.label: Preact
nodes.rationale: The inlined renderer uses Preact vnode fields (__k, __e, __c), hooks (__H), and options such as debounceRendering. The identifier preact is not spelled out.

nodes.label: TreeMap
nodes.rationale: Groups descendant nodes by height so each depth is painted as its own SVG layer.

nodes.label: createFilter
nodes.rationale: Exclude matchers reject a module when both the bundle glob and the file glob match. Include matchers accept it. An empty include list keeps every module that was not excluded.

nodes.label: prepareFilter
nodes.rationale: Splits the sidebar text on commas, trims and unquotes entries, then splits each entry on the first colon into bundle and file globs.

nodes.label: squarify
nodes.rationale: A row accepts another node only while the worst aspect ratio does not get worse. The default ratio is phi, (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2.

nodes.label: treemapResquarify
nodes.rationale: When the parent already stored a squarify partition for the same ratio, that row layout is reused and only the rectangle sizes are updated.

nodes.label: d3-hierarchy
nodes.rationale: hierarchy, treemap, squarify, treemapDice, treemapSlice, and resquarify are the d3-hierarchy layout. The name d3 is not written in the file.

nodes.label: picomatch
nodes.rationale: Vendored so include and exclude filters can test module ids. Fast paths compile common glob patterns to cut parse time. Long backslash runs are collapsed to reduce exploit surface while tokenizing.

nodes.label: bytes
nodes.author: TJ Holowaychuk
nodes.rationale: MIT licensed. Copyright 2012-2014 TJ Holowaychuk and copyright 2015 Jed Watson. Tooltip sizes are passed through bytes.format.

nodes.label: createRainbowColor
nodes.rationale: Top-level groups take hues from a sequential HSL scale. Lightness then follows node depth. Font color is black when WCAG relative luminance is above 0.19 and white otherwise.

nodes.label: FvD 13.37
nodes.rationale: hsl2rgb is attributed to FvD 13.37 and to CSS Color Module Level 3. The file does not expand the abbreviation FvD.

nodes.label: Rendered
nodes.rationale: With sourcemap off, Rendered is the byte size of the individual file after transforms and tree-shaking. With sourcemap on, the same label is the character count after per-module and whole-bundle transforms according to the sourcemap. This report sets sourcemap to false.

nodes.label: Gzip
nodes.rationale: Byte size of the individual file after per-module transforms, tree-shaking, and gzip compression. Shown only when options.gzip is true. This report sets gzip to true.

nodes.label: Brotli
nodes.rationale: Byte size of the individual file after per-module transforms, tree-shaking, and brotli compression. Shown only when options.brotli is true. This report sets brotli to true.

nodes.label: Visualizer data v2
nodes.rationale: const data is schema version 2 with tree, nodeParts, nodeMetas, env.rollup 4.59.0, and options gzip true, brotli true, sourcemap false.

nodes.label: nodeParts
nodes.rationale: Per-module renderedLength, gzipLength, and brotliLength, plus metaUid pointing at nodeMetas.

nodes.label: nodeMetas
nodes.rationale: Module id, moduleParts (chunk file to part uid), imported, and importedBy.

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.rationale: The module tree names \0vite/preload-helper.js and \0vite/modulepreload-polyfill.js, and output files live under assets/ with content hashes.
